attributes.residual:
BEST RETAINED real 144 (T411/O411, multiset 2t, fuzzy 98.66) — unchanged in SCORE from v4, but two things are now closed that v4 left open.

(1) THE JUMPTABLE QUESTION IS SETTLED: THE ROWS ARE NAME NORMALIZATION, NOT A PAYLOAD DIFFERENCE, AND THE PROOF IS NOW AN ADDRESS IDENTITY RATHER THAN AN INFERENCE. v4 flagged 2 regnorm STRUCTURAL rows (R_PPC_ADDR16_HA/LO at 0x40/0x44, target jumptable_80129618 vs our @230) and said they 'should be confirmed before any flip attempt'. Four independent confirmations, all measured this session. (a) The aligned view `fnasm.py game/audio/dcsdrv.c dcsHandleRequest 0x38:0x50 --diff` shows both rows as '~ opcode-only match': identical instructions `lis r3,0` / `addi r3,r3,0`, identical relocation KINDS, differing only in the symbol NAME rendering — the regnorm-annotation-artifact discriminator. (b) fndiff --clean shows our side as `<local>` against the target's `@0x80129618`, which claim.law.parse-strips-the-lbl-address explains as the signature collapse, not a defect. (c) THE NEW AND DECISIVE ONE, available only because this session closed the data gate: our @230 is the second object in our .data at offset 0x50, and the splits claim now landed is 0x801295C8..0x80129680, so @230's link address is 0x801295C8+0x50 = 0x80129618 = jumptable_80129618 EXACTLY — the two names denote one address, and datadiff reports the section 100.0% bytes equal. That converts v4's 'reads as a symbol-name normalization artifact' into a proven address identity. (d) ghostsweep, re-run after the claim, reports 0 own-pool UND ghosts image-wide, and `nm -u` on our object lists NO undefined jumptable_ symbol at all and no UND lbl_ whose address falls inside dcsdrv's own splits ranges — our object DEFINES its jumptables locally, so there is no latent flip-time link failure. CONCLUSION: regnorm's effective STRUCTURAL count for this function is 0, and the jumptable rows do NOT block a flip.

(2) THE COMPOSED WEBFRANK ROUTE IS STRUCTURALLY CLOSED, BY FOUR INDEPENDENT MACHINE-MEASURED BARS. The entire remaining residual is one 3-word window plus a 3-cycle recolor. Ours at [0x1e0,0x1ec) = `li r31,0` / `addi r30,r31,0` / `stw r30,0(r29)`; target = `li r28,0` / `stw r28,0(r30)` / `li r31,0`. Recolor map ours->target is r31->r31, r30->r28, r29->r30, r28->r29 (the formal 3-cycle: ours input=r28/output=r29/request=r30 vs target request=r28/input=r29/output=r30). BAR 1, STEP 0, the C1 membership test: `check_permutation_dependences(ours[0x1e0:0x1ec], order)` REFUSES every candidate order — [1,2,0] and [1,0,2] fail 'breaks def-use chains: [(1, (g,31))]', [2,0,1] fails '[(2, (g,30))]' — and refuses IDENTICALLY with exit_dead=lambda r: True, the loosest escape the API admits. This is the C1 law's non-member signature verbatim: the displacement is CAUSED BY the very copy form the later stage would fix, because our `addi r30,r31,0` READS r31 in our colouring while the target's independent `li r28,0` reads nothing. BAR 2, DIRECTION, and this is a NEW boundary on the LZ class: equivalent_copy_form requires the TARGET word to be a register copy (proof modes are 'unconditional' = both sides copy, and 'dominating_def' = ours li, target copy). HERE THE DIRECTION IS INVERTED — OURS is the copy and the TARGET is the `li`. Measured refusal, both positionally and after a hypothetical permutation: '+0x1e0: target word 0x3b800000 is not a register copy'. The LZ census reports 'addi_copy->li 5' as a real image-wide population, so this direction EXISTS and has no proof mode; the sanctioned class is asymmetric. BAR 3, THE v2 INTERLOCK: even in a hypothetical combined pass, our word writes r30 while the target's writes r28, so the site is a form change AND a recolor at once — the exact camera_mode_level condition the LZ law names as requiring an unbuilt v2 combined stage. BAR 4, INDEPENDENT OF ALL THREE: 0x1e0 is a jumptable case-entry (confirmed, `_jumptable_targets` on our object returns 0x1e0 among 19 targets), so prove_constant_source's backward scan fails closed on 'index reachable by anything but its own fallthrough edge' — the MtapOpenPort refusal — and could never discharge a dominating_def obligation here even if the direction were right. apply_patch's stage order was read directly and is instruction_permutation -> permute_instruction_atoms -> equivalent_copy_form -> copy_register_fields -> verify_consistent_recolor, so no reordering of shipped stages reaches this site either.

(3) SOURCE AXES: the formal-web-priority axis is now dead across BOTH constructs, which is stronger than v3/v4 had. v3 killed the identity-FUNCTION matrix (direct body 389, all-three 271, request+output 154, input-only 265) and v4 killed K&R (neutral). This session adds the plain-LOCAL construct: output-only is NEUTRAL (identical real, identical multiset, identical cluster offsets — i.e. locals and identity functions are interchangeable here), and all-three-in-formal-order REGRESSES to 261 by breaking the lwzu fusion at 0x338 exactly as claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention predicts. Two constructs, eight measured points, the same verdict: no source spelling re-ranks the three formal webs without perturbing the lwzu or addi-copy forms. DO NOT RETRY the passthrough matrix in any construct.

WHAT WOULD REOPEN THIS: only a WebFrank v2 combined permute+form+recolor stage that (i) admits the ours-copy -> target-li direction with a dominating-def proof that tolerates a jumptable case-entry site, and (ii) applies the renaming and the form rewrite together so the permutation legality is evaluated AFTER the form rewrite dissolves the r31 read. Both are postprocessor work, not source work, and (ii) is the same v2 requirement the LZ law already records for camera_mode_level. Nothing in this function is source-reachable.
